title: fiangshi census-receipt anchoring (Aceop-001/fiangshi @ 1d19e408, served census as a function of commit + FIANGSHI_NOW) — pre-registered dual-context offline rebuild with independent receipt-hash recompute, $0.00

subject.component: fiangshi census receipts for two live x402 sellers (api.cleave.fi/x402/gas, api.bitrefill.com/x402/gift-cards/search), anchored as claims in the Argus registry; classification under the record-0028 frozen-procedure discipline (recomputes from the records alone)
subject.vendor_answers: thread comment 7136711046 (2026-11-24 15:50 UTC): a receipt never changes — its id is the sha256 of its canonical JSON, a new verdict is a new receipt with a new id; recompute over the canonical receipt object, not the HTTP response wrapper; current main is 1d19e408…, pin the commit at freeze (a scheduled 36h ALLOW-only refresh may move main after 2026-11-26 01:04 UTC); the served census is a function of the commit and the clock (a refresh counts only once its collection time has passed); no code-level rate limits on the demo routes; /v1/index.json bytes move on every request (served_at, per-record data_age_hours) — its sha256 is a one-time snapshot fingerprint, not a reproducibility claim
subject.demo_shape: $0.00: no paid x402 calls, no keys, no settlements; the live API is touched only for one GET /v1/index.json and the per-receipt verify routes; the receipt chain is rebuilt offline from the pinned commit; receipt hashes are recomputed independently of fiangshi's code by the checker's own Python canonicalizer

notes: PREREG FREEZE (freeze-0032): this draft, PREREG-0032.md (prose twin), argus-fiangshi-probe.ts and census_checker.py land BEFORE the first live GET, committed to igor-vii/Argus-Agent-Test-Lab; the canonical sha256 of the signed wrapper (draft + detached Ed25519 by the agent session key) is published in Aceop-001/fiangshi#1 before the first live GET, per the 0031 discipline. run_ts, self_run, findings_summary and run-pack evidence pins are filled from the run after it completes (re-pin commit before signing, as in 0031).

Pass rule for the final record: seal iff A1–A4, B1–B4 and C1–C3 all match as frozen; any divergence → finding, recorded as-is; the record is complete either way; corrections are separate records, sealed originals are never edited. The L1/L2 rows are evidence-only and never affect the verdict.

Verifier independence: receipt hashes are recomputed by the checker's own Python canonicalizer (not fiangshi's code); fiangshi's verifyReceipt/verifyChain results are recorded alongside as corroboration, not as the source of truth.

What this anchors, honestly: the receipts existed at the pinned commit and their canonical bytes are fixed and re-derivable offline from git history; it says nothing about fiangshi's internal API ledger beyond the anchored bytes (the vendor's own disclosure). fiangshi stays advisory: no signing key, no new call in its request path.

Disclosed choice: the probes run with the repo's pinned tsx (devDeps via npm ci). If the local tsx were missing, the checker aborts rather than silently letting npx download an unpinned tsx; --allow-npx-download exists and its use would be disclosed in the run pack (run_meta.json tsx_source).
